import os,sys,pathlib,stat,hashlib,json,sqlite3,subprocess
root=pathlib.Path('/srv/projects/Telecom-Intelligence-Portugal')
m=json.loads((root/'installation.json').read_text())
assert m['commit']=='2265a73f121b12d291a506457befc47dcef9f64c'
def h(p):
 b=p.read_bytes();return hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(b)).encode()+b'\0'+b).hexdigest()
checked={n:h(root/'source'/n)==v for n,v in m['source_hashes'].items()}
assert all(checked.values()) and len(checked)==6
private_paths=['private/auth','private/backup.key','data/real.sqlite3','backups/initial-empty.enc']
assert all(stat.S_ISREG((root/p).lstat().st_mode) and not ((root/p).lstat().st_mode&0o077) and (root/p).lstat().st_uid==os.geteuid() for p in private_paths)
assert stat.S_IMODE(root.lstat().st_mode)==0o700 and not root.is_symlink()
assert h(root/'tessdata'/'por.traineddata')=='e9f373e95c66b4bf557c263721ef31f78e5bc301'
con=sqlite3.connect('file:'+str(root/'data'/'real.sqlite3')+'?mode=ro',uri=True)
counts={n:con.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM '+n).fetchone()[0] for n in ('contratos','grants','oposicoes','revoked')}
integrity=con.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0];mode=con.execute("SELECT value FROM meta WHERE key='mode'").fetchone()[0];con.close()
assert mode=='real' and integrity=='ok' and counts['contratos']==0
p=subprocess.run([str(root/'venv'/'bin'/'python'),'-m','pip','check'],capture_output=True,timeout=10)
assert p.returncode==0
assert all(subprocess.run(['/bin/sh','-n',str(root/n)],capture_output=True,timeout=3).returncode==0 for n in ('telecom.sh','run-panel.sh'))
port_used=any(l.split()[1].endswith(':223D') and l.split()[3]=='0A' for f in ('/proc/net/tcp','/proc/net/tcp6') for l in open(f).read().splitlines()[1:])
assert not port_used
size=sum(p.stat().st_size for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink())
print('TELECOM_READBACK='+json.dumps({'installed':True,'commit':m['commit'],'verified_sources':len(checked),'directory_mode':'0700','private_files':True,'ocr_hash_ok':True,'dependency_check':True,'launchers_syntax':True,'real_records':counts['contratos'],'grant_records':counts['grants'],'db_integrity':integrity,'port_8765_unused':not port_used,'approx_disk_mib':round(size/2**20,1)},ensure_ascii=True),flush=True)
